decoded:
North Ridge Block 9A final nutrient audit complete.
EnviroScan unit logged median soil nitrate concentration 18.2 ppm but high spatial variance.
Two low-yield zones you flagged, designated LZ-7 and LZ-11, registered 9.8 ppm and 8.1 ppm respectively, both below 12 ppm intervention threshold.
Main block phosphorus adequate 28 kg/ha but potassium trending low 135 kg/ha.
Organic matter composite for block 3.1%.

Given these readings, please execute variable-rate amendment protocol `VRA-9A-Supplement` for next maintenance pass.
Prescription map updated on server with tag `v4_final`.
^Load only polyammonium sulfate blend product code `AS-77` into left-side spreader hopper.
^Target application rate for zones below 12 ppm nitrate is 42 kilograms per hectare.
^For all other areas of Block 9A apply maintenance rate 15 kilograms per hectare.
^Under no circumstances use blended potash mix `PK-30` for this pass; its application deferred until post-harvest window.

Operation must be completed before forecasted rain event now modeled to arrive at 18:00 local time on Thursday.
^Begin spreading no earlier than 10:00 Thursday; allow morning dew evaporation.
^If soil moisture sensor network shows any node above 35% volumetric water content at 09:00, delay commencement; await manual override.
^Coordinate with logistics agent for Silo 3; required 1.8 metric tonnes of `AS-77` allocated under batch identifier `F23-8892`.
^Confirm product scan against this batch ID prior to loading.
^Total allowable runtime for this application capped at 4.5 hours; align with equipment scheduling.
^If spreader flow sensor deviates by more than 5% from prescribed rate for over two minutes, pause operation; generate alert for field supervision.
